OAHelper snapshot • 22 September 2026
Evidence: 6 verified calendar records, 5 approved interview experiences and 19 published non-mock questions. Counts describe records, not unique drives or confirmed attendance.

These are past scheduled dates, not independent confirmation that a campus visit occurred.

  Role: SDE Intern. Time as entered: not recorded.

DRIVE-SPECIFIC CORRECTION
The 24 September NITK Surathkal entry describes interviews after resume shortlisting, with no OA. It must not be treated as a scheduled online assessment.

PACKAGES & ELIGIBILITY — SELECTED REPORTS
• 2026-09-24 | NIT Karnataka Surathkal | SDE Intern
  Package: 1 Lac. CGPA: 7.4. M.Tech eligible: No.

• 2026-09-02 | IIT Delhi | Intern - Software Development
  Package: Intern conversion to FTE / PPO is based on intern's performance and business requirements. PPO Breakdown: Base - INR 16,00,000/- Sign-on Bonus - INR 4,00,000/- RSU (4-yr vesting) - $25,000/- Benefits - Relocation, Health Insurance etc.. CGPA: 7.5+. M.Tech eligible: No.
Figures remain as entered; CTC, base and stipend are not interchangeable. Conflicting figures can reflect different roles or submissions.

WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
A Java internship report describes one greedy DSA task, one Java interface/OOP task, two SQL tasks and five aptitude/CS questions. Interviews included balanced brackets, string manipulation, joins/grouping, coin-style DP, KMP and a later string/graph problem. This was specifically a Java role.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjMxNQ

An Associate Software Engineer record describes 20 CS MCQs, mostly networking, and three coding tasks on strings, linked lists and trees. Subsequent interviews emphasized the OSI model, DSA, project experience and situational questions.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjMxNA

A C developer intern account reports OA work involving hashes, tries, heaps/greedy methods and LIS-style DP. Later interviews covered pointers, odd-frequency detection, divisor/GCD reasoning, interval merging, LCS, operating systems and networks.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjMxMg

An SDE-intern account names IP-address validation and palindrome coding, plus normalization, OOP and request-lifecycle discussion. This lighter account should not override the more specialized C/Java formats.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjMxMw

QUESTION PATTERNS IN OAHELPER
19 published non-mock question records. Types: CODING: 19.
Difficulty labels: Medium: 18, Easy: 1.
19/19 records have usable topic labels.
Most frequent stored topics: Array (9), Hash Table (7), Sorting (6), Graph (6), Greedy (4), String (4), Two Pointers (4), Counting (4).
A question can have several tags. These frequencies describe the uploaded corpus; they do not predict the next OA. Mock and duplicate-marked questions are excluded.

SOURCE NOTES
Compiled from OAHelper’s verified calendar, approved experiences and published question labels as of 22 September 2026. Campus labels in calendar reports can include off-campus applications; an interview author’s college is not necessarily the interview venue. Different roles, seniority levels and dates can have different processes.
